evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-trade realised asset deltas and complete fee decomposition: DEX/platform fees, EVM gas, Solana base/priority/Jito fees, slippage and price impact.
All attempted orders, including rejected, reverted, timed-out, dropped, partially settled and unresolved broadcasts.
Explicit per-attempt classification into STRATEGY, MARKET, EXECUTION or INFRASTRUCTURE with attributable P&L/cost.
Chain-, strategy-, leader-, mint-, route- and venue-level money-weighted net P&L, profit factor, drawdown and tail loss.
Chronological out-of-sample SHADOW results and sample counts by independent market regime.
Entry-to-exit liquidity and sellability evidence at intended follower size.
Signal age, quote age, RPC/API latency, transaction inclusion latency and their measured relationship to execution success, slippage and realised P&L.
Expected-versus-realised cost calibration and evidence that no expected P&L is substituted for unresolved realised outcomes.
Promotion evidence requires positive held-out net P&L after all costs, adequate observations, bounded execution-failure rate, reconciled settlements and no safety-control regression.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer evidence collection and fewer promotion candidates; strict reconciliation may initially expose incomplete historical records.

evidence.detail: A caller-supplied net_profit is accepted without reconciling it to gross profit, gross loss, fees and slippage; gas/priority fees and price impact have no dedicated validation.
PROMOTION_CANDIDATE can follow only three windows and eight trades, aggregates all history without an out-of-sample or recent-regime requirement, and does not gate on execution-failure rate.
Executed statuses include BROADCAST and SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING, and missing realised net falls back to expected net; rejected/failed attempts are excluded rather than recorded as execution failures.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents false promotion from optimistic expected values, incomplete settlements or tiny samples, while enabling explicit STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE attribution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 completed round trips and 100 opportunities per chain, seven daily windows, plus a held-out chronological window containing at least 10 completed trades; larger samples are required for high-variance assets.
proposals.rationale: Promotion must be based on realised, chain-specific, money-weighted results after every cost. Expected outcomes and broadcasts are not realised P&L. Failed attempts must be attributed separately so EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures do not masquerade as STRATEGY/MARKET losses or disappear from evaluation.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, replay at least 100 independently timestamped opportunities per chain and require at least 30 completed round trips across at least seven daily windows. Reconcile net P&L exactly to realised asset deltas minus DEX/platform fees, slippage/impact, gas or Solana base/priority/Jito fees, and failed-attempt costs. Stop and fail the test on any expected-value substitution, unexplained ledger difference, unresolved broadcast, or attribution mismatch.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab evaluation and promotion evidence
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW-only cost-reconciliation evaluator and tests

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative reserves may suppress marginal opportunities, and gas estimates can become stale during rapid fee changes.

evidence.detail: The slippage reserve is calculated as gross_profit multiplied by slippage bps, rather than exposure across the routed notionals; estimated_gas_base is emitted as zero.
Candidate ordering subtracts scanner-provided gas, which is zero for direct-market rows, so ranking can favour economically inferior routes before wallet-specific simulation.
A later wallet-specific simulation and gas-multiple floor fail closed, but they do not correct scanner prioritisation or measure opportunity loss caused by inaccurate preliminary economics.

proposals.expected_effect: Better SHADOW candidate ordering, fewer futile simulations and a more faithful estimate of net edge across EVM chains with different native-token values and gas regimes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 fresh route observations and 30 completed or receipt-grounded simulated cycles per observed EVM chain, spanning at least seven days and multiple gas regimes.
proposals.rationale: EVM economics must reserve multi-leg slippage/price impact against traded notionals and use chain-specific gas, including failed-transaction exposure. The current downstream simulation protects execution, but preliminary ranking is not a reliable executable-net-edge ranking.
proposals.shadow_test: For each supported EVM chain, compare current ranking against a SHADOW ranker using fresh per-wallet simulation, per-leg quoted outputs, route price impact, current gas estimate, builder/platform fees, and a failed-attempt reserve. Score against receipt-confirmed counterfactual net P&L. Fail if the revised estimator understates realised total cost in more than 5% of completed samples, produces non-positive realised aggregate net P&L, or increases simulation/revert failures.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW-only EVM executable-cost ranker and evaluation tests

proposals.downside_risk: More abstention and model error during regime shifts; coarse leader-event timestamps may limit latency calibration.

evidence.detail: Entry qualification uses reconstructed historical and recent median leader returns, which are signal-quality proxies rather than a follower-specific executable net-edge forecast.
The fee cap uses a configured static expected profit margin, while actual opportunity edge can differ by leader, mint, route and market regime.
The execution layer appropriately separates and caps base fee, priority tip, platform-fee equivalent and impact/slippage, providing inputs that a SHADOW net-edge model can consume.

proposals.expected_effect: Calibrates abstention to follower-specific executable economics and reduces copying of signals whose historical leader return does not survive current Solana costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible signals, 30 completed SHADOW round trips, seven daily windows and at least five samples in each reported latency/cost bucket.
proposals.rationale: A leader can be historically profitable while follower latency, route impact, priority fees and exit liquidity eliminate executable edge. Strategy loss must be evaluated after these costs; quote/API/RPC failures and inclusion failures must remain EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE classifications.
proposals.shadow_test: Run the existing decision beside a SHADOW scorer forecasting round-trip follower net P&L from leader-return distribution, signal age, entry and exit quotes, impact, slippage, platform fee, base/priority/Jito fees and failed-attempt probability. Require positive held-out money-weighted net P&L after all costs and calibration error within a declared bound. Stop on missing exit quote, fewer than five samples in a cost/latency bucket, negative held-out net P&L, or any reduction of existing liquidity, sellability, simulation or risk gates.
suggested_files: Strategy Lab/SHADOW-only Solana executable-edge model and attribution tests

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or loosen filters to obtain more wins.
rejected_ideas.reason: Raw win count is not the objective, and no trade is justified without positive executable net edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current strategy to CANARY or LIVE from this review.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are unavailable and fresh-within-2h is false; architecture inspection cannot establish profitability or readiness.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower liquidity, sellability, simulation, fee, reserve or circuit-breaker protections.
rejected_ideas.reason: This would increase tail risk and cannot repair an unsupported strategy edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Automatically add new assets or prioritise low-liquidity tokens.
rejected_ideas.reason: No fresh asset-level execution, sellability or net-P&L evidence was supplied.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally preserves SHADOW/LIVE separation and positive-edge safety gates, but promotion evidence and cost attribution are not sufficiently robust for durable money-weighted net-P&L conclusions. EVM scanner economics understate slippage and omit gas during candidate ranking; Strategy Lab can mix realised and expected results while failing to record execution failures; Solana entry economics use static expected-margin and historical-return proxies rather than a fully executable per-trade net-edge forecast. These are architecture findings, not evidence of current losses or profitability. Missing runtime forensics prohibit profitability, CANARY-readiness and LIVE-readiness claims.
